messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 27):
"""
9.3 Technical Note on Pricing in the standard format specified by IRDAI vide circular no. IRDAI/ACT/CIR/MISC/069/04/2021dated 01.04.2021 (Not applicable to Life Insurers): 9.4 Proposal form, wherever necessary 9.5 Premium Table S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 9.6 Certificates by Appointed Actuary and Chief Compliance Officer 9.7 Product Check List with due certification by Chief Compliance Officer 9.8 Certificate of Insurance, where applicable 9.9 CIS Software used for product design and monitoring — _________________ The Insurer shall enclose a certificate from the Chief Compliance Officer, Appointed Actuary, countersigned by the principal officer of the insurer, as per specimen given below :( The language of this should not be altered) Certification by Chief Compliance Officer: I (Name of Chief Compliance Officer) the undersigned, on behalf of the Insurer named below, hereby affirm and declare as follows: 1.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who must countersign the certificate issued by the Chief Compliance Officer for a health insurance product?","answer":"The certificate must be countersigned by the principal officer of the insurer.","facts":["certificate from the Chief Compliance Officer, countersigned by the principal officer of the insurer"],"source":"passage"},{"question":"What is the required content of the certificate issued by the Chief Compliance Officer?","answer":"It must include the Chief Compliance Officer’s name and the insurer’s name, and affirm and declare the specified statements.","facts":["Certification by Chief Compliance Officer: I (Name of Chief Compliance Officer) the undersigned, on behalf of the Insurer named below, hereby affirm and declare as follows: 1."],"source":"passage"}]}
